name: Spray Caps
description: Eighteen aerosol caps, from Needle to Hardcore Fat, driven by paint rather than by tips. Each deposits real paint at its own flow and fan: move at arm speed and it covers, flick and it thins to speckle, linger or pass over the same spot again and the wet film sags into runs that go only as far as that paint would.
author: HereLiesAz

step: // geometry: the brush size is the cap's nominal width, so layer px per cm follows the brush
// the wet ledger is an 8 px grid: never read or write it through a footprint finer than that
// the can: valve blast at touchdown, a clogged cap sputters
spray(px, py, rl, dh * (rpx * rpx) / (rl * rl));
emit { x: px, y: py, size: 2 * rpx * 2.0, alpha: cover, angle: (0 > 0 ? 0 : rand() * 360), tip: 1 };
// overspray: fine droplets thrown past the edge, more when far
let k = floor(nm) + gate(1 - fract(nm), rand());
emit { x: px + ex * ca - ey * sa, y: py + ex * sa + ey * ca, size: ds, alpha: 0.5 + 0.45 * rand(), angle: 0, tip: 1 };
// a film thicker than the wall holds sags: the excess leaves the wall and goes into runs
pend = min(0.4, pend + rel * 0.0001 * PI * rc * rc / 3);
// runs: each moves down the wall, slowing as it dries, spending its own paint
if (adv0 * need0 > d0v) { adv0 = d0v / need0; }
emit { x: d0x + (noise(y10 * 0.012 + 0.0) - 0.5) * pxcm, y: y10, size: d0w * pxcm * 1.4 * 2.0, alpha: 0.97, angle: 0, tip: 1 };
